verdict.rationale: CSC's own marketing says it offers integrations with ELM, claims and payroll systems through secure APIs, and 'secure bi-directional integrations... via modern APIs' for entity management. That means an API exists, but it appears to be delivered as a vendor-led integration service, not a self-serve public API. Probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec and no llms.txt, so nothing shows the API is publicly documented or usable by an AI-native user directly. missing for 10: publicly accessible API reference documentation, self-serve API keys/auth, a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI), endpoint coverage details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
